title: m3_config.toml
description: Generated by bin/gen_config_docs.py from the m3 config registry.

read_log.description: Record who read which memory, and when (memory_access_log).

read_log_retention_days.description: Days the read-access log keeps a row before maintenance prunes it.

chatlog_prune_auto.description: Let the loop prune the chatlog without review (today .cognitive_loop_config.json wins).

consolidation_auto.description: Let the loop apply belief consolidation without review.

distill_auto.description: Let the loop apply distilled procedures without review.

auto_enrich.description: Queue an observation after an ingest of chatlog.auto_enrich_min_turns or more turns.

auto_enrich_min_turns.description: Turns an ingest needs before chatlog.auto_enrich queues an observation.

statusline_ascii.description: Use [!] instead of the warning sign in the status line.

pool_size.description: SQLite connections in the chatlog pool.

pool_timeout_s.description: Seconds: the chatlog's SQLite busy timeout AND its pool checkout wait (one value, two uses today).

deadline_s.description: Seconds one sweeper run may take; 0 or less is unbounded.

max_drain_attempts.description: Attempts to drain a spilled chatlog batch (today .spill_config.json wins).

allow_fallback.description: Allow embedding through the cloud enclave when local tiers fail (privacy gate).

auth_token_keyring.description: Keyring entry holding the enclave token, as service:user or user (service m3_memory). A REFERENCE, not the secret; the secret is M3_CLOUD_AUTH_TOKEN.

backend.description: Crypto backend: DEFAULT or WOLFSSL (forced by crypto.fips_mode / fips_strict). (Today an unknown value acts as DEFAULT; it is now an error.)

fips_mode.description: FIPS 140-3 mode: wolfSSL/wolfCrypt is required and any failure is fatal.

fips_strict.description: Also require the CMVP-validated wolfCrypt build (implies the wolfSSL backend).

wolfssl_lib.description: The wolfSSL library file tried first; unset searches the trusted lib dirs.

wolfssl_sha256.description: Integrity pin for the wolfSSL library; checked when wolfSSL initialises.

llm_block_ttl_s.description: Seconds an endpoint that failed the smoke test is skipped.

llm_smoke.description: Let the dashboard send a small test prompt to each LLM endpoint.

llm_smoke_ttl_s.description: Seconds an LLM smoke result is cached.

backend.description: Primary storage backend. The one key env may override (CI, containers).

pool_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for a pooled SQLite connection.

sqlite_mmap_size.description: SQLite mmap_size in bytes; unset keeps the pragma profile's own value.

dispatch_schema.description: Schema holding the dispatch queue on PostgreSQL.

forbidden_hosts.description: Hosts a PRIMARY store must never connect to (e.g. the warehouse); selecting one is refused.

pg_dump.description: pg_dump used for snapshots; unset finds it on PATH. pg_restore is looked for beside it.

pool_max.description: Maximum connections in the PostgreSQL pool (at least pool_min).

pool_min.description: Minimum connections in the PostgreSQL pool.

upsert_page_size.description: Rows per bulk upsert page; lower it over a slow link (U4 D: a deliberate tuning knob).

mode.description: Dispatch queue store: separate (its own) or integrated (the main store). (Today an unknown value acts as separate; it is now an error.)

autodetect.description: Search the disk for a bge-m3 GGUF when embed.gguf is unset.

autodetect_budget_s.description: Seconds the GGUF discovery walk may take.

compatible_models.description: Other model tags whose vectors share this space.

ctx.description: Context length in tokens (also read by the Rust core, as a u32; CONFIG_DESIGN §6).

discovery_negative_ttl_s.description: Seconds an endpoint that failed discovery is skipped.

fallback_model_tag.description: Tag of vectors from the fallback endpoint. Default: embed.model.

fallback_url.description: The fallback embedding endpoint (the shared embed server).

gguf.description: The GGUF weights file. Unset: m3's models root, the bundled asset, then discovery (embed.autodetect). Not an env override (user decision, m3 a24fa878).

gguf_model_tag.description: Tag of vectors from the in-process GGUF embedder. Default: embed.space_tag.

init_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the in-process embedder to load; 0 disables the limit.

inproc.description: Allow the in-process tier-1 embedder (opt-in, DESIGN_PHILOSOPHIES §8).

model.description: The embedding model name requested from the endpoint.

require_unit_norm.description: Reject vectors whose norm is not 1 within embed.norm_tolerance.

search_deadline_s.description: Seconds a search waits for its query embedding; 0 disables the limit.

space_tag.description: The vector space rows are tagged with; decides search compatibility. Default: embed.model.

url.description: Embedding endpoint override; unset uses the configured endpoints.

cloud_reset_s.description: Seconds the cloud tier's breaker stays open.

cloud_threshold.description: Consecutive failures that open the cloud tier's breaker.

cpu_fallback_reset_s.description: Seconds the cpu_fallback tier's breaker stays open.

cpu_fallback_threshold.description: Consecutive failures that open the cpu_fallback tier's breaker.

embedded_reset_s.description: Seconds the embedded tier's breaker stays open.

embedded_threshold.description: Consecutive failures that open the embedded tier's breaker.

primary_reset_s.description: Seconds the primary tier's breaker stays open.

primary_threshold.description: Consecutive failures that open the primary tier's breaker.

host.description: Address the GPU embed proxy binds.

model_path.description: GGUF file llama-server loads. Unset: models/qwen3-q8.gguf under the CURRENT directory (a working-directory-dependent default; 2D fixes it).

keepalive_expiry_s.description: Seconds an idle kept-alive connection lives.

bin.description: The m3-embed-server binary; unset uses the wheel's, then PATH.

concurrency.description: Concurrent requests; 0 uses the backend's stream pool.

host.description: Address the shared embed server binds (also read by the Rust server).

interactive_max_texts.description: Largest request still treated as interactive.

port.description: Port of the shared embed server (also read by the Rust server, as a u16).

budget_usd.description: Spending cap for one run, in US dollars; unset is uncapped.

conv_list.description: File listing the conversations to enrich.

input_max_k.description: Input cap in KiB; unset uses the profile's own.

max_attempts.description: Attempts before a conversation is dead-lettered.

send_to.description: --resume: only conversations assigned to this provider.

track_state.description: Record per-conversation enrichment state (forced on by --resume and budgets).

conv_list.description: File listing the conversations to extract entities from.

extract_max_attempts.description: Attempts before an entity extraction is given up.

resolve_cosine_min.description: Embedding similarity at which two entity names resolve to one entity.

resolve_fuzzy_min.description: Fuzzy-match score at which two entity names resolve to one entity.

seed_stoplist.description: Words never used as graph seeds (case-insensitive).

vocab_yaml.description: Entity vocabulary. Unset: config/lists/entity_graph_default.yaml (the m3_entities CLI uses entity_graph_m3.yaml; 2D makes them one).

automerge_cosine.description: Similarity at which two entities merge automatically.

flag_cosine.description: Similarity at which a pair is flagged for review.

fuzzy_high.description: Fuzzy-name score (0-100) that counts as a strong match.

max_cluster.description: Largest same_as cluster an automatic merge may build.

model.description: Extraction model; unset picks the best LLM.

type.description: Extractor: rule_based, an LLM provider, or custom_script. (Today an unknown value acts as rule_based; it is now an error.)

write_through.description: Extract inline on write instead of queueing.

default_corpus.description: Corpus a file is ingested into when none is named.

default_extract_mode.description: Fact extraction on ingest: none, inline, or queued for the loop.

extract_min_leaf_chars.description: Leaves shorter than this are not sent to extraction.

extract_model.description: Extraction model. Default: files.summary_model, then the endpoint's discovered model.

extract_url.description: Extraction endpoint. Default: files.summary_url, then M3_LMSTUDIO_URL, then the failover list.

follow_symlinks.description: Follow symbolic links while walking a directory.

max_files_per_ingest.description: Files one ingest call may take.

prewarm_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the summary model to load before an ingest.

promo_half_life_days.description: Half-life of the promotability score's recency term (values below 1 act as 1).

promotion_scope.description: Scope given to memories promoted from files.

summary_model.description: Summary model. Default: the endpoint's discovered model.

summary_url.description: Summary endpoint. Default: M3_LMSTUDIO_URL; unset disables summaries.

device.description: Device: cuda (falls back to mps, then cpu), cpu, or a torch device.

config_ttl_s.description: Seconds between checks of .governor_config.json for changes.

feedback_window_minutes.description: Minutes of feedback the maintenance pass considers.

initial_threshold.description: Load percent at which the governor starts throttling.

limit_threshold.description: Load percent at which the governor halts background work.

ram_halt_gb.description: Free RAM (GB) below which background work halts.

ram_throttle_gb.description: Free RAM (GB) below which background work throttles.

ram_throttle_idle_gb.description: Free RAM (GB) below which work throttles while the user is idle.

probe_ttl_s.description: Seconds a GPU probe result is cached.

node_id.description: Sync node identity. Default: the host name (upper-cased on Windows).

origin_device.description: Device name stamped on memories. Default: the host name.

auto_entities.description: Extract entities with the LLM on ingest.

auto_title.description: Title memories with the LLM on ingest.

event_rows.description: Write event rows on chat ingest.

gist_min_turns.description: Turns a conversation needs for a gist.

gist_rows.description: Write gist rows on chat ingest.

window_chunks.description: Write windowed chunks on chat ingest.

auto_install.description: Let `m3` install a missing payload on first run.

os_install_timeout_s.description: Seconds an unattended OS package install may take.

agent_id.description: Agent id the Hermes plugin writes as.

home.description: Hermes Agent's home; unset uses HERMES_HOME, then probed locations.

user_id.description: User id the Hermes plugin writes as.

connect_timeout_s.description: Seconds to connect to an endpoint before trying the next.

endpoints.description: LLM endpoints tried in order (base URLs). Empty: llm.url, then LM Studio.

lmstudio_base.description: LM Studio's base URL for the MCP proxy (no M3_ name exists today).

lmstudio_failover.description: Include LM Studio in the failover list. Default: on unless llm.url is set.

lmstudio_url.description: LM Studio endpoint the files summarizer and extractor fall back to.

ollama_failover.description: Include Ollama (localhost:11434) in the failover list.

outage_repeat_s.description: Seconds before an ongoing outage is reported again.

read_timeout_s.description: Seconds the MCP proxy waits for a model's reply.

timeout_s.description: Seconds an LLM call may take.

url.description: A custom LLM endpoint, tried first.

usability_ttl_s.description: Seconds an endpoint's usability result is cached.

max_bytes.description: Task log size that triggers rotation; 0 disables rotation.

task_log_file.description: A scheduled task's log file. Default: <logs root>/<task>.log.

classify_deadline_s.description: Seconds a classify pass may take.

distill_model.description: Procedure distillation model: slm, llm, or a profile name.

limit_per_pass.description: Items one loop pass takes (the governor shrinks it).

throttled_limit.description: Items per loop pass under THROTTLED load.

allow_destructive.description: Let proxies run catalog tools marked not default-allowed. Off: they are blocked.

auto_related_link.description: Link a new memory to related ones on write.

auto_related_link_scope_by_variant.description: Only link memories within the same variant.

disable_auto_activation.description: Never switch features on automatically from data volume (an explicit flag still wins).

enforce_agent_isolation.description: Restrict a search to the requesting agent's memories.

entity_graph.description: Build the entity graph on write.

fact_enrich_max_attempts.description: Attempts before a fact extraction is given up.

inline_classify.description: Classify memory type inline on write instead of in the loop.

threshold.description: Similarity above which a write is checked for contradiction.

title_gate.description: Title agreement a contradiction needs: strict, loose or off. (Today any other value acts as off; it is now an error.)

type_exclusions.description: Memory types never checked for contradiction.

enabled.description: Record corroborating writes instead of storing duplicates.

threshold.description: Similarity above which a write corroborates an existing memory.
Similarity above which two memories are duplicates.

no_embed.description: Do not embed the observations the observer writes.

assets.description: The payload's _assets/ directory for a non-packaged install (installer.py _payload_dir); unset uses the packaged one.

bin.description: The bin/ directory of a non-packaged (developer) install; unset uses the packaged one.

docs.description: The payload's docs/ directory for a non-packaged install (installer.py _payload_dir); unset uses the packaged one.

engine_root.description: Databases and runtime state. Default: <memory_root>/engine, else ~/.m3/engine.

examples.description: The payload's examples/ directory for a non-packaged install (installer.py _payload_dir); unset uses the packaged one.

lib_dir.description: Where the wolfSSL library is trusted from. Default: <config root's parent>/lib.

logs_root.description: Scheduled-task and service logs. Default: <memory_root>/logs, else ~/.m3/logs.

memory_root.description: Legacy master root: config, engine, logs and models derive from it when their own keys are unset. Removed at N+3 (CONFIG_DESIGN §9).

models_root.description: GGUF weights m3 owns. Default: <memory_root>/models, else ~/.m3/models.

bypass_surface_cap.description: Entity-bypass results surfaced (1-5000; today a larger value is clamped).

confidence_ranking.description: Blend memory confidence into the score.

confidence_weight.description: Weight of confidence when search.confidence_ranking is on.

elbow_abs_threshold.description: Score drop that counts as the elbow.

elbow_min_input.description: Fewest results before elbow truncation applies.

expansion_displacement_margin.description: How far an expanded result must outscore one it displaces.

expansion_protected_ranks.description: Top ranks query expansion may not displace.

importance_weight.description: Weight of a memory's importance in ranking.

intent_procedural_boost.description: Boost for procedures on a procedural intent.

intent_user_fact_boost.description: Boost for user facts on a user-fact intent.

observation_budget_tokens.description: Tokens of observations a two-stage search returns.

router_temporal_k_bump.description: Extra results a temporal query fetches.

short_turn_threshold.description: Turns shorter than this (characters) are down-weighted.

speaker_in_title.description: Index the speaker in chat-turn titles.

supersedes_penalty.description: Multiplier for a superseded memory's score (1.0 = no penalty).

title_match_boost.description: Score added when the query matches the title.

two_stage_turn_penalty.description: Multiplier for raw turns in a two-stage search.

file.description: The user-only plaintext secrets file, for hosts where no keyring serves m3's headless jobs (CONFIG_DESIGN §10). Default: <config root>/m3_secrets.toml.

macbook_status_host.description: Address the macbook status server binds.

classifier.description: Use the SLM to classify search intent.

profile.description: Default SLM profile for intent classification.

profile_dirs.description: Extra directories searched first for SLM profiles (os.pathsep-separated in env).

timeout_s.description: Seconds one warehouse sync may take.

warehouse_host.description: Warehouse host. Default: sync.target_ip, then the warehouse DSN's host.

lazy.description: Load MCP tool domains on demand.

timeout_s.description: Seconds a tool call may take; 0 or less disables. Unset: each tool's own, else 30.
Seconds a compile call may take.
Seconds a judge call may take.

url.description: Citation-drift and derivability judge URL. Default: wiki.synth.url.

model.description: Synthesis model; unset uses the server's.

timeout_s.description: Seconds a synthesis call may take.
